test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A class of 30 students took an exam, with the average score of 12 students being 68 and the average score of the rest being 70. What is the average score of the class?
solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 30

Average of 12 students = 68

Average of remaining 18 students = 70

**Formula used:**

Total marks = (Average × Number of students)

Class average = Total marks ÷ Total students

**Calculations:**

Marks of first 12 students = 12 × 68 = 816

Marks of remaining 18 students = 18 × 70 = 1260

⇒ Total marks = 816 + 1260 = 2076

⇒ Class average = 2076 ÷ 30 = 69.2

**∴ The average score of the class = 69.2**
